title: Connectivity-stopped worker starts VPN apply and consumes the due occurrence
reproduction: With a named set and its enabled URL overdue, stop the real worker for a connectivity constraint just before targeted retrieval returns. An independent disabled URL is also overdue.
expected: Do not begin apply after the stop. Leave due clocks untouched for the next eligible run.
observed: Debug baseline called apply once after stop (expected zero); the old success path then wrote completion clocks.
fix: Recheck the worker stop flag between retrieval and apply; return retry before acknowledging any due schedule.
test_evidence: API 34 red then green; fresh worker imports the two local rules and applies exactly once. Separate disabled source remains disabled and overdue. See deep-signoff/scheduled-due.md.
